title: Refinancing the Balloon of a Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract
content:
The balloon refinance rule sets the refinance installment when the balloon of a Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract is refinanced at the customer's request, and the refinance is booked on the contract.

## When the installment is fixed

The refinance installment is fixed only after a payoff quote dated on the refinance date stands on the contract. The refinance installment is not fixed until a payment dated on the refinance date stands held on the contract with nothing yet applied to it.

Read together: the refinance installment has no fixed amount while either no payoff quote dated the refinance date stands on the contract, or no payment dated the refinance date stands held on the contract with nothing yet applied to it.

## Days past due and late-charge history

For a balloon refinance booked under this rule, and only for such a refinance, the days-past-due condition is met when a payment held on the contract with nothing yet applied covers every amount due other than the balloon installment, because a held payment is applied when the refinance is booked; the late charges in the 12 calendar months ending on the request date must still not exceed the tier's refinance late-charge limit. The status, window and once-per-contract conditions of the balloon refinancing rule are unchanged.

## Booking: `complete_balloon_refinance_14b47e8c`

**Capability.** One call books one balloon refinance entry dated today and re-amortizes the contract: the principal balance becomes the amount refinanced, interest is paid to today, any fees due are cleared (booked as one fee payment entry for the fees standing, linked to the most recent payment dated today when there is one) so fees due become 0.00, the APR and monthly payment are replaced by the refinance APR and installment, the balloon amount becomes 0.00, the refinance date becomes today, the elected maturity option is recorded as refinance, nothing is past due, the next installment falls due one month from today and the maturity date moves to today plus the refinance term in months.

**Invocation.** Agent-side: the agent unlocks `complete_balloon_refinance_14b47e8c` and calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `balloon_contract_id` | The reference number of the balloon contract being refinanced, as returned by the balloon contract lookup for the verified customer | Id string |
| `amount` | The amount refinanced | USD, decimal number with 2 decimal places (cents), already rounded to the cent, no currency symbol |
| `refinance_term_months` | The refinance term | Whole number of monthly installments (integer, months) |
| `refinance_apr` | The refinance annual percentage rate | Percent, decimal number with 2 decimal places, written without the % sign |
| `refinance_monthly_payment` | The new level monthly installment | USD, decimal number with 2 decimal places (cents), already rounded to the cent, no currency symbol |

**Return.** A confirmation sentence stating the refinance entry reference, the amount refinanced in USD with 2 decimal places, the term in months (integer), the APR in percent with 2 decimal places, the monthly installment in USD with 2 decimal places, the fees cleared in USD with 2 decimal places, the next due date and the new maturity date in YYYY-MM-DD form. Receiving it means the refinance is booked.
